user.title: Kindle dashboard
user.description: Pick the entities shown on the dashboard and when the Kindle should refresh. Every field can be changed later under Configure.

data.full_refresh_every: Full screen refresh every N updates

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Shown as the large temperature. Falls back to the weather entity when unavailable.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_entity: Optional. Falls back to the weather entity.
data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Shown next to the house icon. Leave empty to hide it.
data_description.prices_entity: Sensor with 15-minute price lists in its data_today and data_tomorrow attributes (€/kWh). Drives the 6-hour chart and the official part of the 6-day chart.
data_description.tomorrow_available_entity: On when tomorrow's official prices are published.
data_description.price_forecast_entity: Optional. Fills the 6-day chart (in light gray) for hours without official prices.
data_description.dishwasher_entity: Load Scheduler schedule sensor whose next period gives the dishwasher start time.
data_description.dishwasher_running_entity: Optional. When on, the card shows "Run now".
data_description.schedule: When the Kindle wakes up to fetch a new image. One period per line as start-end and interval in minutes, e.g. "08:30-00:00 30" = every 30 minutes from 08:30 to midnight. Periods may cross midnight. Shorter intervals keep the screen fresher but use more battery. Changes reach the Kindle at its next check-in (the sleep it is already in is not shortened).
data_description.default_interval: Used for any time of day that no line in the schedule covers.
data_description.offset_seconds: The Kindle wakes this many seconds after each scheduled time, so a new 15-minute price slot has already started when the image is drawn. 60 is a good default.
data_description.full_refresh_every: E-ink keeps faint ghosts of earlier images. Every Nth update the screen flashes black once to clear them. Lower = cleaner screen, more flashing.
data_description.grace_minutes: The Check-in problem sensor turns on when the Kindle has not fetched an image this long after its expected check-in, e.g. it crashed, lost wifi or ran out of battery.

error.invalid_options: Check the schedule and numeric options. {error}

init.title: Kindle dashboard options
init.description:
The Kindle fetches `{image_path}` from this Home Assistant (debug info: `{status_path}`).

Secret token: `{token}`. Put it in TOKEN in the Kindle's config.sh.

Changes here apply to the image immediately and to the refresh schedule from the Kindle's next check-in; nothing needs changing on the Kindle.
